---
title: "01_datacleaning_primary"
output: html_document
---

## Overview

Cleans the raw SOEP files and constructs the primary first-time-parent couple
sample for the transition-to-parenthood analyses.

Primary design decisions:

- SOEP source coverage is 1984-2024; first births are restricted to 1985-2020.
- Candidate partners are identified from `pgen$pgpartnr` with `pgpartz` codes
  1-4, then independently verified against the exact `BIOCOUPLM$partnr`
  relationship episode and required to be reciprocal.
- Couples must consist of one male and one female partner (mixed-gender dyads).
- Prior unions, divorce, or widowhood are not exclusion criteria by themselves.
- Both partners must report the same first-child birth year. One valid birth-month
  report is sufficient because it refers to the same shared child; if both report
  a valid month, the reports must agree.
- The first-child event is anchored to the survey reporting year. If a respondent
  was interviewed in the biological birth year, child-birth month is compared
  with interview month. If there was no interview in that calendar year, the
  reporting year is set to the following year. Both partners must map the shared
  first birth to the same reporting year.
- Primary second-child rule: exclude couples whose first and second biological
  birth years are consecutive. Also exclude couples where partners report
  conflicting second-birth years, where at least one partner reports two or more
  children but neither partner provides a usable second-birth year, or where the
  recorded second birth precedes the first (data error). Do NOT censor later
  observations because of a later second child in the primary analysis.
- Same-year second-child records are retained under the stated consecutive-year
  rule (e.g., multiple births are not automatically excluded).
- The exact same cohabiting relationship must cover the full theoretical
  eight-position window (signals 0-7).
- As an additional annual co-residence check, whenever both partners have an
  observed positive PGEN household ID (`hid`) in a signal year, the IDs must
  agree. A missing household ID alone is not treated as evidence that the
  couple was not co-residing.
- A positive annual `pgpartnr` record naming a different partner during the
  window is treated as a conflict and excluded; a missing annual link alone is
  not treated as proof that the relationship ended because BIOCOUPLM supplies
  the longitudinal relationship episode.
- Life satisfaction is validated to the 0-10 scale; values outside this range
  are set to missing.
- Signals 0, 2, and 3 are mandatory. Signal 1 is optional.
- Each partner must have at least 6 of the 8 life-satisfaction observations.
- The structurally eligible parent grid is saved before the 6/8 rule is applied,
  so that the multi-group analysis (script 03) can use the broader parent pool.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(haven)
library(here)

options(scipen = 999)
dir.create(here("data", "derived"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

FIRST_BIRTH_MIN <- 1985
FIRST_BIRTH_MAX <- 2020
PARTNER_STATUS_CODES <- c(1, 2, 3, 4)
MANDATORY_SIGNALS <- c(0, 2, 3)
MIN_LS_OBS <- 6
EXCLUDE_CONFLICTING_PARTNER_LINKS <- TRUE
EXCLUDE_OBSERVED_HID_MISMATCH <- TRUE

assert_unique <- function(data, keys, object_name) {
  dup <- data %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(keys))) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(n > 1)

  if (nrow(dup) > 0) {
    print(head(dup, 20))
    stop(object_name, " is not unique on: ", paste(keys, collapse = ", "))
  }
}

first_nonmissing <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) NA_real_ else x[[1]]
}
```

```{r load-raw}
wellbeing <- readRDS(here("data", "wellbeing.rds"))
pgen      <- readRDS(here("data", "pgen.rds"))      %>% zap_labels()
biobirth  <- readRDS(here("data", "biobirth.rds"))  %>% zap_labels()
biocouplm <- readRDS(here("data", "biocouplm.rds")) %>% zap_labels()

cat("\n--- Source coverage ---\n")
cat("wellbeing years:", min(wellbeing$syear, na.rm = TRUE), "to",
    max(wellbeing$syear, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("pgen years:     ", min(pgen$syear, na.rm = TRUE), "to",
    max(pgen$syear, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("BIOCOUPLM endy: ", min(biocouplm$endy[biocouplm$endy > 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    "to", max(biocouplm$endy[biocouplm$endy > 0], na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

assert_unique(pgen, c("pid", "syear"), "pgen")
```

```{r clean-core-datasets}
# Life satisfaction
swb <- wellbeing %>%
  transmute(
    syear,
    pid = as.numeric(pid),
    cid,
    hid,
    life_sat = if_else(plh0182 %in% 0:10, as.numeric(plh0182), NA_real_)
  )
assert_unique(swb, c("pid", "syear"), "swb")

cat("\nLife-satisfaction range among valid values:",
    paste(range(swb$life_sat, na.rm = TRUE), collapse = " to "), "\n")

# Interview month. Invalid/nonpositive SOEP codes become NA.
month <- pgen %>%
  transmute(
    syear,
    pid = as.numeric(pid),
    cid,
    hid,
    pgen_row_exists = TRUE,
    interview_month = if_else(
      imonth %in% 1:12,
      as.numeric(imonth),
      NA_real_
    )
  )
assert_unique(month, c("pid", "syear"), "month")

# Annual partner links. pgpartz 1-4 are eligible candidate spouse/partner links;
# exact relationship identity is subsequently verified against BIOCOUPLM.
partner_data_all <- pgen %>%
  transmute(
    syear,
    hid,
    cid,
    pid = as.numeric(pid),
    partner_id = if_else(pgpartnr > 0, as.numeric(pgpartnr), NA_real_),
    partner_status = as.numeric(pgpartz),
    marital_status = as.numeric(pgfamstd)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(partner_id))

cat("\n--- pgpartz among person-years with a positive partner PID ---\n")
print(partner_data_all %>% count(partner_status))

partner_data <- partner_data_all %>%
  filter(partner_status %in% PARTNER_STATUS_CODES)

n_strict_12 <- partner_data_all %>%
  filter(partner_status %in% c(1, 2)) %>%
  nrow()

cat("Retained pgpartz codes:", paste(PARTNER_STATUS_CODES, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Person-years under strict codes 1/2:", n_strict_12, "\n")
cat("Additional person-years contributed by codes 3/4:",
    nrow(partner_data) - n_strict_12, "\n")
cat("Total retained candidate partner person-years:", nrow(partner_data), "\n")

# Keep all annual partner IDs for the later conflict check.
partner_link_all <- pgen %>%
  transmute(
    pid = as.numeric(pid),
    syear,
    raw_pgpartnr = as.numeric(pgpartnr),
    partner_id_obs = if_else(pgpartnr > 0, as.numeric(pgpartnr), NA_real_),
    partner_status_obs = as.numeric(pgpartz)
  )
assert_unique(partner_link_all, c("pid", "syear"), "partner_link_all")

# Annual household IDs used as a positive co-residence check later.
# Only positive HIDs are treated as observed; missing/invalid IDs do not by
# themselves count against a couple.
annual_hid <- pgen %>%
  transmute(
    pid = as.numeric(pid),
    syear,
    hid_pgen = if_else(
      as.numeric(hid) > 0,
      as.numeric(hid),
      NA_real_
    )
  )
assert_unique(annual_hid, c("pid", "syear"), "annual_hid")

# Birth history
birth_data <- biobirth %>%
  transmute(
    cid,
    pid = as.numeric(pid),
    sex = if_else(sex %in% c(1, 2), as.numeric(sex), NA_real_),
    num_child = if_else(sumkids >= 0, as.numeric(sumkids), NA_real_),
    first_birth = if_else(kidgeb01 > 0, as.numeric(kidgeb01), NA_real_),
    first_month = if_else(kidmon01 %in% 1:12, as.numeric(kidmon01), NA_real_),
    second_birth = if_else(kidgeb02 > 0, as.numeric(kidgeb02), NA_real_),
    second_month = if_else(kidmon02 %in% 1:12, as.numeric(kidmon02), NA_real_),
    raw_second_birth = as.numeric(kidgeb02),
    raw_second_month = as.numeric(kidmon02)
  )
assert_unique(birth_data, "pid", "birth_data")

pre_consec_filter <- birth_data %>%
  filter(
    first_birth >= FIRST_BIRTH_MIN,
    first_birth <= FIRST_BIRTH_MAX
  )

cat("\nPeople with a valid first birth in",
    FIRST_BIRTH_MIN, "-", FIRST_BIRTH_MAX, ":",
    n_distinct(pre_consec_filter$pid), "\n")
```

```{r relationship-spells}
# BIOCOUPLM spelltyp 1 = married/spouse in household;
# spelltyp 3 = cohabiting partner in household.
relationship_spells <- biocouplm %>%
  transmute(
    pid = as.numeric(pid),
    partner_id = if_else(partnr > 0, as.numeric(partnr), NA_real_),
    coupid,
    spellnr,
    spelltyp = as.numeric(spelltyp),
    beginy = as.numeric(beginy),
    endy = as.numeric(endy),
    censor = as.numeric(censor)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    spelltyp %in% c(1, 3),
    !is.na(partner_id),
    beginy > 0,
    endy > 0,
    endy >= beginy
  )

# Collapse overlapping/adjacent cohabiting->married spells for the same exact
# partner, while preserving genuine gaps as separate episodes.
relationship_episodes <- relationship_spells %>%
  arrange(pid, partner_id, beginy, endy) %>%
  group_by(pid, partner_id) %>%
  mutate(
    previous_max_end = lag(cummax(endy)),
    new_episode = if_else(
      row_number() == 1L | beginy > previous_max_end + 1,
      1L,
      0L
    ),
    episode_id = cumsum(new_episode)
  ) %>%
  group_by(pid, partner_id, episode_id) %>%
  summarise(
    cohabit_start = min(beginy),
    cohabit_end = max(endy),
    spell_types = paste(sort(unique(spelltyp)), collapse = "+"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(total_duration = cohabit_end - cohabit_start)

cat("\nCohabiting relationship episodes:", nrow(relationship_episodes), "\n")
cat("Unique pid-partner pairs:",
    relationship_episodes %>% distinct(pid, partner_id) %>% nrow(), "\n")

# Compatibility name used by later scripts.
relationship_duration <- relationship_episodes
```

```{r identify-reciprocal-couples}
# Verify each annual candidate partner link against the exact BIOCOUPLM partner
# episode containing that survey year.
partner_verified <- partner_data %>%
  inner_join(
    relationship_episodes,
    by = c("pid", "partner_id"),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    syear >= cohabit_start,
    syear <= cohabit_end
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    couple_id = paste0(pmin(pid, partner_id), "_", pmax(pid, partner_id))
  )

assert_unique(partner_verified, c("pid", "syear"), "partner_verified")

couple_members_raw <- partner_verified %>%
  distinct(couple_id, pid, partner_id)

valid_pair_ids <- couple_members_raw %>%
  group_by(couple_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_members = n_distinct(pid),
    n_partner_ids = n_distinct(partner_id),
    reciprocal = setequal(unique(pid), unique(partner_id)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    n_members == 2,
    n_partner_ids == 2,
    reciprocal
  ) %>%
  select(couple_id)

couple_members <- couple_members_raw %>%
  semi_join(valid_pair_ids, by = "couple_id")

cat("\nReciprocal exact-partner couples identified:",
    n_distinct(couple_members$couple_id), "\n")
```

```{r shared-first-child}
birth_reports <- couple_members %>%
  inner_join(pre_consec_filter, by = "pid")

birth_agreement <- birth_reports %>%
  group_by(couple_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_members = n_distinct(pid),
    n_first_years = n_distinct(first_birth, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_valid_months = sum(!is.na(first_month)),
    n_first_months = n_distinct(first_month, na.rm = TRUE),
    couple_first_birth = first_nonmissing(first_birth),
    couple_first_month = first_nonmissing(first_month),
    n_male = sum(sex == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_female = sum(sex == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    conflicting_first_month = n_valid_months == 2 & n_first_months != 1
  )

cat("\n--- Shared first-child checks ---\n")
cat("Candidate couples with two birth-history records:",
    sum(birth_agreement$n_members == 2), "\n")
cat("Couples disagreeing on first-birth YEAR:",
    sum(birth_agreement$n_members == 2 & birth_agreement$n_first_years != 1), "\n")
cat("Couples with no valid first-birth month from either partner:",
    sum(birth_agreement$n_members == 2 & birth_agreement$n_valid_months == 0), "\n")
cat("Couples with exactly one valid first-birth month:",
    sum(birth_agreement$n_members == 2 & birth_agreement$n_valid_months == 1), "\n")
cat("Couples with two valid first-birth months that DISAGREE:",
    sum(birth_agreement$n_members == 2 & birth_agreement$conflicting_first_month), "\n")
cat("Couples not exactly one male + one female:",
    sum(
      birth_agreement$n_members == 2 &
        !(birth_agreement$n_male == 1 & birth_agreement$n_female == 1)
    ), "\n")

# One valid month can describe the shared child. If both partners provide a
# month, the values must agree. Month can remain missing here if neither reports
# one; it becomes necessary only when an interview occurred in the biological
# birth year and before/after timing must be resolved.
shared_birth_ids <- birth_agreement %>%
  filter(
    n_members == 2,
    n_first_years == 1,
    !conflicting_first_month,
    n_male == 1,
    n_female == 1
  )

cat("Couples retained after shared first-child + heterosexual checks:",
    nrow(shared_birth_ids), "\n")

birth_member_data <- birth_reports %>%
  semi_join(shared_birth_ids %>% select(couple_id), by = "couple_id") %>%
  inner_join(
    shared_birth_ids %>%
      select(couple_id, couple_first_birth, couple_first_month),
    by = "couple_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    first_birth = couple_first_birth,
    first_month = couple_first_month
  )
```

```{r first-child-reporting-year}
first_anchor_person <- birth_member_data %>%
  select(
    couple_id, pid, partner_id, sex, num_child,
    first_birth, first_month, second_birth, second_month
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    month %>% select(pid, syear, pgen_row_exists, interview_month),
    by = c("pid", "first_birth" = "syear")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pgen_row_exists = replace_na(pgen_row_exists, FALSE),
    first_reporting_year = case_when(
      !pgen_row_exists ~ first_birth + 1,
      pgen_row_exists & !is.na(interview_month) &
        !is.na(first_month) & first_month <= interview_month ~ first_birth,
      pgen_row_exists & !is.na(interview_month) &
        !is.na(first_month) & first_month > interview_month ~ first_birth + 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

first_anchor_check <- first_anchor_person %>%
  group_by(couple_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_members = n_distinct(pid),
    n_birthyear_interviews = sum(pgen_row_exists),
    n_valid_reporting_years = sum(!is.na(first_reporting_year)),
    n_reporting_years = n_distinct(first_reporting_year, na.rm = TRUE),
    reporting_year = first_nonmissing(first_reporting_year),
    first_birth = first(first_birth),
    first_month = first(first_month),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\n--- First-child reporting-year alignment ---\n")
cat("Couples with no birth-year interview for either partner:",
    sum(first_anchor_check$n_birthyear_interviews == 0), "\n")
cat("Couples with exactly one birth-year interview:",
    sum(first_anchor_check$n_birthyear_interviews == 1), "\n")
cat("Couples with two birth-year interviews:",
    sum(first_anchor_check$n_birthyear_interviews == 2), "\n")
cat("Couples with an unassignable reporting year for >=1 partner:",
    sum(first_anchor_check$n_valid_reporting_years < 2), "\n")
cat("Couples where partners map first birth to different reporting years:",
    sum(
      first_anchor_check$n_valid_reporting_years == 2 &
        first_anchor_check$n_reporting_years != 1
    ), "\n")

couple_anchor <- first_anchor_check %>%
  filter(
    n_members == 2,
    n_valid_reporting_years == 2,
    n_reporting_years == 1
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    window_start = reporting_year - 3,
    window_end = reporting_year + 4
  )

cat("Couples retained after first-child reporting-year alignment:",
    nrow(couple_anchor), "\n")
cat("Theoretical windows ending after the last wellbeing year:",
    sum(couple_anchor$window_end > max(wellbeing$syear, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")
```

```{r primary-second-child-rule}
# PRIMARY rule: exclude first and second children born in consecutive biological
# calendar years. No later-second-child censoring is applied to the primary
# trajectory.
primary_second_child <- birth_member_data %>%
  semi_join(couple_anchor %>% select(couple_id), by = "couple_id") %>%
  group_by(couple_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_members = n_distinct(pid),
    first_birth = first(first_birth),
    n_second_years = n_distinct(second_birth, na.rm = TRUE),
    couple_second_birth = first_nonmissing(second_birth),
    conflicting_second_year = n_second_years > 1,
    unresolved_second_year =
      all(is.na(second_birth)) & any(num_child >= 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    second_before_first =
      !is.na(couple_second_birth) & couple_second_birth < first_birth,
    same_year_second =
      !is.na(couple_second_birth) & couple_second_birth == first_birth,
    consecutive_birth_years =
      !is.na(couple_second_birth) & couple_second_birth == first_birth + 1,
    year_difference = if_else(
      !is.na(couple_second_birth),
      couple_second_birth - first_birth,
      NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\n--- Primary second-child rule ---\n")
cat("Couples entering rule:", nrow(primary_second_child), "\n")
cat("Couples with conflicting valid second-birth years:",
    sum(primary_second_child$conflicting_second_year), "\n")
cat("Couples with >=2 children but no usable second-birth year from either partner:",
    sum(primary_second_child$unresolved_second_year), "\n")
cat("Couples with second birth before first (data error):",
    sum(primary_second_child$second_before_first), "\n")
cat("Couples with first and second child in the SAME calendar year (retained if otherwise valid):",
    sum(primary_second_child$same_year_second), "\n")
cat("Couples with first and second child in CONSECUTIVE calendar years (excluded):",
    sum(primary_second_child$consecutive_birth_years), "\n")

primary_second_keep <- primary_second_child %>%
  filter(
    !conflicting_second_year,
    !unresolved_second_year,
    !second_before_first,
    !consecutive_birth_years
  ) %>%
  select(
    couple_id,
    couple_second_birth,
    same_year_second,
    consecutive_birth_years,
    year_difference
  )

cat("Couples retained after primary second-child rule:",
    nrow(primary_second_keep), "\n")

# Compatibility object for downstream flow descriptions.
post_consec_filter <- birth_member_data %>%
  semi_join(primary_second_keep %>% select(couple_id), by = "couple_id")
```

```{r build-eight-position-window}
parent_members <- couple_members %>%
  semi_join(couple_anchor %>% select(couple_id), by = "couple_id") %>%
  semi_join(primary_second_keep %>% select(couple_id), by = "couple_id") %>%
  inner_join(
    birth_member_data %>%
      select(
        couple_id, pid, sex, num_child,
        first_birth, first_month, second_birth, second_month
      ),
    by = c("couple_id", "pid")
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    couple_anchor %>%
      select(couple_id, reporting_year, window_start, window_end),
    by = "couple_id"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    primary_second_keep,
    by = "couple_id"
  )

parent_window <- parent_members %>%
  tidyr::uncount(weights = 8, .id = "signal") %>%
  mutate(
    signal = signal - 1L,
    syear = window_start + signal
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    swb %>% select(pid, syear, cid, hid, life_sat),
    by = c("pid", "syear")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    month %>% select(pid, syear, interview_month),
    by = c("pid", "syear")
  )

assert_unique(parent_window, c("couple_id", "pid", "syear"), "parent_window")
```

```{r full-window-relationship}
# Require the exact same BIOCOUPLM relationship episode to span the full
# theoretical signals 0-7 window for both partners.
window_members <- parent_window %>%
  distinct(couple_id, pid, partner_id, window_start, window_end)

qualifying_episode_person <- window_members %>%
  inner_join(
    relationship_episodes,
    by = c("pid", "partner_id"),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    cohabit_start <= window_start,
    cohabit_end >= window_end
  ) %>%
  arrange(couple_id, pid, desc(cohabit_start)) %>%
  group_by(couple_id, pid) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

relationship_ok_couples <- qualifying_episode_person %>%
  group_by(couple_id) %>%
  summarise(n_members = n_distinct(pid), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_members == 2) %>%
  select(couple_id)

parent_window <- parent_window %>%
  semi_join(relationship_ok_couples, by = "couple_id")

qualifying_episode_person <- qualifying_episode_person %>%
  semi_join(relationship_ok_couples, by = "couple_id")

couple_relationship <- qualifying_episode_person %>%
  group_by(couple_id) %>%
  summarise(
    couple_cohabit = max(cohabit_start),
    couple_cohabit_end = min(cohabit_end),
    start_year_difference = max(cohabit_start) - min(cohabit_start),
    window_start = first(window_start),
    window_end = first(window_end),
    rel_duration_signal0 = window_start - couple_cohabit,
    full_theoretical_window_covered = TRUE,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\n--- Exact-partner relationship checks ---\n")
cat("Couples retained after exact relationship covers full signals 0-7:",
    nrow(couple_relationship), "\n")
cat("Couples with >1-year disagreement in relationship-episode start (diagnostic only):",
    sum(couple_relationship$start_year_difference > 1), "\n")
cat("Relationship duration at signal 0 -- summary:\n")
print(summary(couple_relationship$rel_duration_signal0))
stopifnot(all(couple_relationship$rel_duration_signal0 >= 0))
```

```{r partner-constancy}
# BIOCOUPLM is the primary source for longitudinal relationship continuity.
# Exclude only positive annual evidence naming a different partner.
constancy_check <- parent_window %>%
  distinct(couple_id, pid, partner_id, signal, syear) %>%
  left_join(partner_link_all, by = c("pid", "syear")) %>%
  group_by(couple_id, pid) %>%
  summarise(
    n_same_partner = sum(partner_id_obs == partner_id, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_conflicting_partner = sum(
      !is.na(partner_id_obs) & partner_id_obs != partner_id,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n_no_positive_partner_link = sum(is.na(partner_id_obs)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\n--- pgen partner-link constancy check ---\n")
cat("People with a positive conflicting partner during signals 0-7:",
    sum(constancy_check$n_conflicting_partner > 0), "\n")
cat("Couples with >=1 positive conflicting partner report:",
    constancy_check %>%
      group_by(couple_id) %>%
      summarise(conflict = any(n_conflicting_partner > 0), .groups = "drop") %>%
      summarise(n = sum(conflict)) %>%
      pull(n), "\n")
cat("Median number of window years with no positive pgpartnr link:",
    median(constancy_check$n_no_positive_partner_link), "\n")

if (EXCLUDE_CONFLICTING_PARTNER_LINKS) {
  no_conflict_couples <- constancy_check %>%
    group_by(couple_id) %>%
    summarise(
      conflict = any(n_conflicting_partner > 0),
      n_members = n_distinct(pid),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(n_members == 2, !conflict) %>%
    select(couple_id)

  parent_window <- parent_window %>%
    semi_join(no_conflict_couples, by = "couple_id")

  couple_relationship <- couple_relationship %>%
    semi_join(no_conflict_couples, by = "couple_id")
}

n_after_partner_conflict <- n_distinct(parent_window$couple_id)

cat("Couples after partner-constancy rule:",
    n_after_partner_conflict, "\n")
```

```{r full-window-co-residence}
# BIOCOUPLM remains the primary longitudinal relationship source, but use the
# annual PGEN household ID as an additional positive-evidence co-residence
# check. If both partners have observed HIDs in the same signal year and the
# HIDs differ, the couple is not treated as co-residing in that year.
#
# Missing HIDs are NOT exclusionary.

co_residence_year <- parent_window %>%
  distinct(couple_id, pid, signal, syear) %>%
  left_join(
    annual_hid,
    by = c("pid", "syear")
  ) %>%
  group_by(couple_id, signal, syear) %>%
  summarise(
    n_members = n_distinct(pid),
    n_hid_observed = sum(!is.na(hid_pgen)),
    n_distinct_hid = n_distinct(hid_pgen, na.rm = TRUE),
    observed_hid_mismatch =
      n_members == 2 &
      n_hid_observed == 2 &
      n_distinct_hid > 1,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\n--- Full-window annual household co-residence check ---\n")
cat("Couple-years with two observed but different HIDs:",
    sum(co_residence_year$observed_hid_mismatch), "\n")

hid_mismatch_couples <- co_residence_year %>%
  group_by(couple_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_signal_years = n_distinct(signal),
    any_hid_mismatch = any(observed_hid_mismatch),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(any_hid_mismatch)

cat("Couples with >=1 observed HID mismatch:",
    nrow(hid_mismatch_couples), "\n")

if (nrow(hid_mismatch_couples) > 0) {
  cat("Mismatched couple-years by signal:\n")
  print(co_residence_year %>% filter(observed_hid_mismatch) %>% count(signal))
}

if (EXCLUDE_OBSERVED_HID_MISMATCH) {
  co_residence_ok_couples <- co_residence_year %>%
    group_by(couple_id) %>%
    summarise(
      n_signal_years = n_distinct(signal),
      any_hid_mismatch = any(observed_hid_mismatch),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(
      n_signal_years == 8,
      !any_hid_mismatch
    ) %>%
    select(couple_id)

  parent_window <- parent_window %>%
    semi_join(co_residence_ok_couples, by = "couple_id")

  couple_relationship <- couple_relationship %>%
    semi_join(co_residence_ok_couples, by = "couple_id")
}

n_after_co_residence <- n_distinct(parent_window$couple_id)

cat("Couples after annual HID co-residence rule:",
    n_after_co_residence, "\n")
```

```{r life-satisfaction-eligibility}
# Save the structurally valid, event-aligned primary parent grid BEFORE the
# parent-only outcome-completeness rule. This is the appropriate broader parent
# object for later comparison-group work.
parent_window_candidates <- parent_window

person_ls_eligibility <- parent_window %>%
  group_by(couple_id, pid) %>%
  summarise(
    n_ls = sum(!is.na(life_sat)),
    signal0 = any(signal == 0 & !is.na(life_sat)),
    signal2 = any(signal == 2 & !is.na(life_sat)),
    signal3 = any(signal == 3 & !is.na(life_sat)),
    mandatory_ok = signal0 & signal2 & signal3,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\n--- Life-satisfaction eligibility ---\n")
cat("People with all mandatory signals 0,2,3:",
    sum(person_ls_eligibility$mandatory_ok), "of",
    nrow(person_ls_eligibility), "\n")
cat("People with >=", MIN_LS_OBS, "of 8 observations:",
    sum(person_ls_eligibility$n_ls >= MIN_LS_OBS), "\n")
cat("People satisfying both rules:",
    sum(
      person_ls_eligibility$mandatory_ok &
        person_ls_eligibility$n_ls >= MIN_LS_OBS
    ), "\n")

eligible_people <- person_ls_eligibility %>%
  filter(
    mandatory_ok,
    n_ls >= MIN_LS_OBS
  )

eligible_ls_couples <- eligible_people %>%
  group_by(couple_id) %>%
  summarise(n_members = n_distinct(pid), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_members == 2) %>%
  select(couple_id)

parent_window <- parent_window %>%
  semi_join(eligible_ls_couples, by = "couple_id")

couple_relationship <- couple_relationship %>%
  semi_join(eligible_ls_couples, by = "couple_id")

cat("Couples retained after both partners meet LS criteria:",
    n_distinct(parent_window$couple_id), "\n")

# Signal 1 remains optional.
pre_birth_coverage <- parent_window %>%
  filter(signal %in% 0:2) %>%
  group_by(couple_id, pid) %>%
  summarise(n_pre_birth_years = sum(!is.na(life_sat)), .groups = "drop")
cat("Observed pre-birth signals (0-2) among retained people:\n")
print(pre_birth_coverage %>% count(n_pre_birth_years))
```

```{r final-parent-objects}
parent_window <- parent_window %>%
  inner_join(
    couple_relationship %>%
      select(
        couple_id,
        couple_cohabit,
        couple_cohabit_end,
        rel_duration_signal0,
        full_theoretical_window_covered
      ),
    by = "couple_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    relationship_duration_at_syear = syear - couple_cohabit
  )

pid_couple_check <- parent_window %>%
  distinct(pid, couple_id) %>%
  count(pid, name = "n_couples") %>%
  filter(n_couples > 1)

if (nrow(pid_couple_check) > 0) {
  print(pid_couple_check)
  stop("At least one participant belongs to more than one final parent couple.")
}

ls_partner <- parent_window

ls_partner_d1 <- parent_window %>%
  filter(
    signal %in% MANDATORY_SIGNALS,
    !is.na(life_sat)
  )

ls_partner_data <- parent_window %>%
  filter(!is.na(life_sat))

parent_couple_info <- parent_window %>%
  group_by(couple_id) %>%
  summarise(
    first_birth = first(first_birth),
    first_month = first(first_month),
    reporting_year = first(reporting_year),
    window_start = first(window_start),
    window_end = first(window_end),
    couple_second_birth = first(couple_second_birth),
    year_difference = first(year_difference),
    same_year_second = first(same_year_second),
    couple_cohabit = first(couple_cohabit),
    couple_cohabit_end = first(couple_cohabit_end),
    rel_duration_signal0 = first(rel_duration_signal0),
    full_theoretical_window_covered = first(full_theoretical_window_covered),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\n--- FINAL PARENT SAMPLE ---\n")
cat("Couples:", n_distinct(ls_partner_data$couple_id), "\n")
cat("Participants:", n_distinct(ls_partner_data$pid), "\n")
cat("Observed person-years:", nrow(ls_partner_data), "\n")

flow_summary <- tibble(
  stage = c(
    "Reciprocal exact-partner couples",
    "Shared first birth + heterosexual",
    "Aligned first-child reporting year",
    "After biological consecutive-birth rule",
    "Exact relationship covers full 0-7 window",
    "After partner-conflict check",
    "After annual HID co-residence check",
    "Both partners meet LS rule"
  ),
  couples = c(
    n_distinct(couple_members$couple_id),
    nrow(shared_birth_ids),
    nrow(couple_anchor),
    nrow(primary_second_keep),
    nrow(relationship_ok_couples),
    n_after_partner_conflict,
    n_after_co_residence,
    n_distinct(ls_partner_data$couple_id)
  )
)

cat("\n--- FLOW SUMMARY ---\n")
print(as_tibble(flow_summary))

# How many final couples had pgpartz 3 or 4 during the study window?
cat("\nFinal couples with pgpartz 3 or 4 during study window:",
    partner_verified %>%
      inner_join(
        parent_couple_info %>%
          select(couple_id, window_start, window_end),
        by = "couple_id"
      ) %>%
      filter(
        between(syear, window_start, window_end),
        partner_status %in% c(3, 4)
      ) %>%
      distinct(couple_id) %>%
      nrow(), "\n")

# How many final couples had a second child during the post-event follow-up?
# Aligned to reporting_year (signal 3), so signals 4-7 = reporting_year+1 to +4.
cat("Final couples with a second child's birth year in post-event years +1 to +4:",
    sum(!is.na(parent_couple_info$couple_second_birth) &
        parent_couple_info$couple_second_birth >= parent_couple_info$reporting_year + 1 &
        parent_couple_info$couple_second_birth <= parent_couple_info$reporting_year + 4,
        na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

```{r sanity-checks}
member_check <- ls_partner_data %>%
  distinct(couple_id, pid, sex) %>%
  group_by(couple_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_members = n_distinct(pid),
    n_male = sum(sex == 1),
    n_female = sum(sex == 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
stopifnot(all(member_check$n_members == 2))
stopifnot(all(member_check$n_male == 1 & member_check$n_female == 1))

obs_check <- ls_partner_data %>%
  count(couple_id, pid, name = "n_obs")
stopifnot(all(obs_check$n_obs >= MIN_LS_OBS & obs_check$n_obs <= 8))

mandatory_check <- ls_partner_data %>%
  filter(signal %in% MANDATORY_SIGNALS) %>%
  group_by(couple_id, pid) %>%
  summarise(
    has0 = any(signal == 0),
    has2 = any(signal == 2),
    has3 = any(signal == 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
stopifnot(all(mandatory_check$has0 & mandatory_check$has2 & mandatory_check$has3))
stopifnot(all(ls_partner_data$signal %in% 0:7))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(ls_partner_data[, c("pid", "syear")]))

shared_event_check <- ls_partner_data %>%
  distinct(couple_id, pid, first_birth, first_month, reporting_year) %>%
  group_by(couple_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_birth_year = n_distinct(first_birth),
    n_birth_month = n_distinct(first_month),
    n_reporting_year = n_distinct(reporting_year),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
stopifnot(all(shared_event_check$n_birth_year == 1))
stopifnot(all(shared_event_check$n_birth_month <= 1))
stopifnot(all(shared_event_check$n_reporting_year == 1))

# Primary second-child rule must hold in the final sample.
stopifnot(!any(
  !is.na(parent_couple_info$couple_second_birth) &
    parent_couple_info$couple_second_birth == parent_couple_info$first_birth + 1
))

# Exact relationship must cover all theoretical positions 0-7.
stopifnot(all(parent_couple_info$full_theoretical_window_covered))

# Final couples must have no signal year in which both observed PGEN HIDs differ.
final_hid_check <- ls_partner %>%
  distinct(couple_id, pid, signal, syear) %>%
  left_join(
    annual_hid,
    by = c("pid", "syear")
  ) %>%
  group_by(couple_id, signal, syear) %>%
  summarise(
    n_members = n_distinct(pid),
    n_hid_observed = sum(!is.na(hid_pgen)),
    n_distinct_hid = n_distinct(hid_pgen, na.rm = TRUE),
    observed_hid_mismatch =
      n_members == 2 &
      n_hid_observed == 2 &
      n_distinct_hid > 1,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stopifnot(!any(final_hid_check$observed_hid_mismatch))

# Final sample counts must match the manuscript.
# Update these values only if the sample-construction logic is intentionally
# changed.  Any unexpected deviation signals a code or data error.
stopifnot(
  n_distinct(ls_partner_data$couple_id) == 679L,
  n_distinct(ls_partner_data$pid) == 1358L,
  nrow(ls_partner_data) == 10746L
)

cat("\nObserved LS counts per person:\n")
print(obs_check %>% count(n_obs))

cat("\nCouples by first-birth year:\n")
print(as_tibble(parent_couple_info %>% count(first_birth)))

cat("\nRelationship duration at signal 0:\n")
print(as_tibble(
  parent_couple_info %>%
    count(rel_duration_signal0) %>%
    arrange(rel_duration_signal0)
))

cat("\nSecond-child status in final primary sample:\n")
print(as_tibble(
  parent_couple_info %>%
    count(
      has_second_birth = !is.na(couple_second_birth),
      same_year_second
    )
))

# Diagnostic only: check whether the theoretical eight-year observation
# windows fall entirely within the available SOEP life-satisfaction data period.
data_first_year <- min(swb$syear, na.rm = TRUE)
data_last_year <- max(swb$syear, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("\n--- FINAL SAMPLE PANEL-BOUNDARY DIAGNOSTIC ---\n")
print(
  parent_couple_info %>%
    summarise(
      final_couples = n(),
      window_starts_before_data = sum(window_start < data_first_year),
      window_ends_after_data = sum(window_end > data_last_year),
      fully_inside_SOEP_period = sum(
        window_start >= data_first_year & window_end <= data_last_year
      )
    )
)
```

```{r sensitivity-input}
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SENSITIVITY INPUT ONLY -- DOES NOT AFFECT PRIMARY SAMPLE SELECTION
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Save the information needed to implement a later Krämer & Rodgers-style
# second-child reporting/censoring sensitivity analysis in a separate script.
# Keeping this separate prevents the alternative censoring rule from changing
# the primary 6/8 completeness criterion.
kr_second_child_sensitivity_input <- first_anchor_person %>%
  semi_join(couple_anchor %>% select(couple_id), by = "couple_id") %>%
  select(
    couple_id,
    pid,
    partner_id,
    sex,
    num_child,
    first_birth,
    first_month,
    first_reporting_year,
    second_birth,
    second_month
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    month %>%
      select(pid, syear, pgen_row_exists, interview_month) %>%
      rename(
        second_birth_year_interview_exists = pgen_row_exists,
        second_birth_year_interview_month = interview_month
      ),
    by = c("pid", "second_birth" = "syear")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    second_birth_year_interview_exists =
      replace_na(second_birth_year_interview_exists, FALSE)
  )

cat("\nSensitivity-input rows saved for later second-child censoring analysis:",
    nrow(kr_second_child_sensitivity_input), "\n")
```
